summary: GFL Environmental furnished a Form 6-K (US equivalent: current report on Form 8-K) disclosing that HPS Investment Partners, on behalf of holders of the Series A perpetual convertible preferred shares, gave notice to convert 4,867,006 preferred shares into 6,219,896 subordinate voting shares; no Series A Preferred remains outstanding. HPS-managed funds sold the converted shares in a block trade at US$42.73 per share, implying roughly US$266 million of stock placed. No board recommendation or advisor was named. The conversion removes the preferred overhang and shifts the capital structure toward common equity; watch for follow-on selling pressure and index/float effects.
